target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
mkdir -p /tmp/probe
probe() {
  ./collatz_tests spectral-gaps --moduli 27 --tilts 0 --L $1 --R $2 --bmax 20 --char-cap 0 --output-dir /tmp/probe >/dev/null 2>&1
  v=$(grep -v '^#' /tmp/probe/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$7==9{print $17}')
  r=$(grep -v '^#' /tmp/probe/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$7==9{print $8}')
  printf "L=%-3s R=%-3s : quadratic gap_ratio=%s  rho=%s\n" "$1" "$2" "$v" "$r"
}
probe 24 4; probe 48 6; probe 96 12; probe 24 2; probe 64 8; probe 120 16
